abort.already_configured: This eufy lock is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This eufy account does not match the account this integration was set up with. Sign in with the original account.
abort.unknown_challenge: eufy asked for a login challenge this integration does not know how to answer. Sign in once in the eufy app, then try again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the eufy cloud. Check that Home Assistant can reach the internet and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The eufy email or password was rejected. Check them and try again.
error.invalid_captcha: That captcha answer was not accepted. Try again — a new captcha image is in the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_code: That verification code was not accepted. Check the code eufy e-mailed and try again.
error.invalid_country: Enter a two-letter country code, for example US.
error.invalid_serial: Enter the lock serial, for example T85V0… (find it in the eufy app, under the lock's device settings).
error.lock_not_found: No lock with that serial was found on this eufy account. Check the serial — it must match the lock in the eufy app.
error.rate_limited: eufy is rate-limiting sign-ins for this account. Wait a few minutes and try again — retrying immediately can extend the lockout.
error.session_replaced: Another eufy app or device signed in with this account and ended this session. Signing in again here will end that other session. Use a separate eufy account shared to the lock if you can.

captcha.description: eufy needs a captcha to sign in. The captcha image is in the Home Assistant log (search for “eufy login needs a captcha”) — open the data-URI link in a browser and type the characters you see. The captcha id is {captcha_id}.
captcha.title: eufy captcha

reauth_confirm.description: The eufy session for {email} needs to be renewed. Enter the account password to sign in again. Signing in again will end any other eufy session using this account.
reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate eufy Who Unlocked

user.description: Sign in to the eufy account the FamiLock S3 Max belongs to. Home Assistant listens to eufy push notifications directly — no bridge or extra device is needed. The password is stored only in Home Assistant's private credential store, never in the config entry. Use a separate eufy account shared to the lock, not your primary account, if you can.
user.title: Connect eufy Who Unlocked

verify_code.description: eufy e-mailed a two-step verification code to {email}. Enter it to finish signing in.
verify_code.title: eufy verification code

data.reconcile: Reconcile with the eufy cloud every 10 minutes

init.description: Reconciliation re-asks the eufy device list to confirm the cloud is still reachable. It is off by default: the integration is push-only, and a poll can only re-seed locked/unlocked — it can never recover who unlocked during a push gap.
init.title: eufy Who Unlocked options
